title: Compute pressure fallback
blurb: An interactive card that steps through WebGL refraction, 30 fps 2D drawing, on-demand 2D drawing and plain HTML via moveBefore() as Compute Pressure rises from nominal to critical.
question: Can PressureObserver step a live interactive drawable canvas down through rendering tiers (WebGL shader, 30 fps 2D, on-demand 2D and plain HTML via moveBefore()) as CPU or thermal pressure rises from nominal to critical, without losing input state or dropping frames?
